features.title: TCD1304 frame codec: envelope, CRC-16/CCITT, resyncing reader
features.summary: Pure parsing/encoding layer for protocol v1. Content-addressed framing, no position-based reads.
features.notes: 16-byte header, little-endian: magic 'T','C' | version 0x01 | type | seq u16 | payload_len u16 | integ_ms u32 | status u16 | reserved u16. CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, no reflection, no final XOR) over header+payload, stored LE. Reject version != 0x01, type outside 1..=5, payload_len > 7388 — on any rejection discard ONE byte and rescan. Keep crc16_ccitt from the old serial.rs:25 verbatim.
acceptance: CRC check value for "123456789" is 0x29B1
A frame prefixed with garbage containing a false 'TC' still parses
A one-byte-truncated frame does not desync the reader permanently

features.title: Replace serial.rs with a TCD1304 SpectrumDriver
features.summary: Delete the specbench driver and implement the same SpectrumDriver trait against the real protocol.
features.notes:
Handshake: X
, 50ms, flush, *IDN?
 (require 4 comma fields, fields[1]=="TCD1304"), M
 and cache metadata. scan(): push I<ms> only on change, then A
, read one SPECTRUM with a 3*integ_ms+500ms timeout (1s for everything else); clear the whole RX buffer on timeout. Samples are SIGNED i16 LE, 3694 of them; invert for display as max_intensity - raw (CCD video reads high in the dark). Saturation comes from metadata MAX_INTENSITY, never a constant. Surface status bit 0 (DROPPED) — the frame is valid, just one integration late; mask bit 0 specifically, bits 4-6 are reserved for a future state machine. Ignore unknown METADATA keys. An ERR frame is an Err regardless of the awaited type.
acceptance: cargo test passes against the simulator from E6
Unknown METADATA keys do not break the parse
A saturated pixel is reported as saturated, not as a large positive value

features.title: Probe-based device discovery and runtime connect/disconnect
features.summary: Find the spectrometer by asking it who it is, and make the UI Connect button actually open the port.
features.notes: No VID/PID filtering: serialport is built default-features=false and libudev-dev is not installed, so available_ports() cannot report VID/PID. The device also ships the stock Renesas 045B:5310 pair with a constant USB serial string, so VID/PID would not identify it anyway. Enumerate available_ports(), keep ttyACM*/ttyUSB*/cu.usbmodem*/COM*, probe each with the E2b handshake, keep the ones answering TCD1304. JASPER_PORT stays as a manual override and is the only way to reach the pty simulator. AppState.driver is already Arc<Mutex<Box<dyn SpectrumDriver + Send>>> so connect can swap its contents. ipc.connectDevice (ipc.ts:127) is dead code today — InstrumentWorkspace.tsx:193 only calls setActiveDevice locally.
acceptance: device_list() returns exactly one TCD1304 with the simulator running
Connect/Disconnect in the UI opens and closes the port for real
A non-spectrometer serial device on the machine is not disturbed beyond one probe

features.title: Make acquisition params honest, and add a backpressure gate to the stream
features.summary: The UI exposes controls the hardware has no command for, the acquisition loop runs faster than a capture can complete, and it emits frames into the webview with no consumer gate.
features.notes: Integration slider is 5-500 step 5 (ActionShelf.tsx:40); the device clamps to 8-10000 ms and reports the applied value in the ACK — clamp to the metadata range and echo the ACK back into the store. Averaging has no device support; keep it host-side via process::average_scans (process.rs:27), which already exists. light_on/light_power cross the IPC boundary but no driver reads them and this hardware has no lamp command — hide those controls behind the E1 flag, leave the AcqParams fields. Acquisition loop interval floor is max(integration,16) at commands/instrument.rs:112; a capture costs about 2x integration because the firmware discards one frame, so the floor must be 2*integ_ms or every iteration blocks and starves the driver mutex. BACKPRESSURE (added after reading the PyQt6 reference): the loop emits spectrum-frame unconditionally at commands/instrument.rs:143; each frame is 3694 points, so at short integration times the webview falls progressively behind instead of tracking newest. Port the gate from '~/Desktop/Spectrum Analyzer python' src/spectrum_analyzer/pipeline/worker.py: an AtomicBool set before emit and cleared by a frame_consumed command the frontend invokes after rendering. Continuous drops frames while the gate is set; single-shot NEVER drops, because every frame must reach the averaging accumulator. Test shape: tests/pipeline/test_worker_backpressure.py.
acceptance: Setting integration to 3 ms yields an ACK of 8 and the slider snaps to 8
The acquisition loop does not starve other commands of the driver mutex
No lamp controls are visible
With a deliberately slow renderer, continuous mode drops frames rather than queueing them, and the trace stays current
A single-shot 8-frame average receives all 8 frames

features.title: Port the Legendre auto-calibration from the PyQt6 reference
features.summary: The device stores no calibration and the firmware roadmap keeps it that way, so JASPER owns pixel-to-nm. A complete working implementation already exists in the PyQt6 reference — port it rather than shipping manual coefficient entry.
features.notes: SCOPE CHANGED: originally 'manual coefficients first, neon auto-fit deferred'. Unnecessary — '~/Desktop/Spectrum Analyzer python' src/spectrum_analyzer/math/calibration.py is a complete working auto-calibration. Port end to end: detect_peaks() (scipy find_peaks, height as a fraction of max, min pixel distance, then sub-pixel 3-point quadratic refine from math/peaks.py); _best_anchor_map() (RANSAC over ordered pairs of tallest peaks x reference lines, scored on DISTINCT lines hit, which is what rejects degenerate near-flat maps); _match_peaks_to_lines() (greedy nearest-neighbour in ascending error order, each peak and each line consumed at most once); legfit degree 2 or 3; fit_quality() for R2 and RMS. Copy the neon (43 lines, already extended past the C++ original against real hardware) and mercury-argon (22 lines) tables verbatim. LEGENDRE BASIS, not raw polynomial: map pixel to [-1,1] as 2*i/(n-1)-1 before evaluating — the dead serial.rs:132 used raw Horner on the pixel index and at 3694 pixels p^5 is about 6.8e17, ill-conditioned exactly where this sensor lives. Storage: instrument_cal table keyed on the IDN serial (MCU unique ID; the USB serial string descriptor is a constant on every board), forward-compatible with the firmware reserved E command. With no calibration loaded, fall back to the pixel axis REGARDLESS of the configured axis setting — what AxisGenerator.generate() does. XCalResult (driver.rs:81) already carries coefficients/rms/peaks_found and ipc.ts:170 already delivers them to the UI, where they are discarded today. PERF: _best_anchor_map is O(candidates^2 x lines^2), about 120k inner iterations — one-shot behind a Fit button with an abort path, as the reference wires it via _FitThread in gui/dialogs/calibration.py. Never run it per frame.
acceptance: Fitting against a neon capture returns coefficients with RMS under 1 nm and reports R2 and matched line count
Save, restart the app, reconnect the same serial — the x-axis returns in nm
A different instrument serial does not pick up another unit calibration
With no calibration, the axis reads pixel index and says so
The fit runs off the UI thread and can be aborted

features.title: pty simulator for the TCD1304 protocol, and rewrite the integration test
features.summary: There is no simulator for this protocol in either repo, and the existing test passes silently when its simulator is missing.
features.notes: The hardware repo has only an in-process _FakeDevice (tcd1304.py:366) that Rust cannot reach. Write pty.openpty(), print the slave path on stdout as the first line, then port the _FakeDevice command dispatch and build_frame() (tcd1304.py:135) verbatim — about 40 lines. serial_sim.rs currently drives claude_hw_design/tools/protocol-sim/sim.py, which belongs to the old protocol, and skips silently if it is absent (serial_sim.rs:36). A missing simulator must FAIL the test, not pass it.
acceptance: python3 tools/tcd1304-sim.py prints a pty path
cargo test passes against it end to end
Deleting the simulator makes the test fail rather than pass

features.title: Generate the x-axis from stored calibration, not inside the driver
features.summary: xs is built once inside the driver at port open and shipped in every SpectrumFrame, so the wavelength axis is baked in by the layer furthest from the display and changing a calibration requires reconnecting.

features.title: CI: cargo test, tsc, eslint on push and PR
features.summary: This repository has no CI. Nothing checks that a PR compiles.
features.notes: Trigger on push to master/feature/**/fix/** and on PRs to master. Run npm ci then npx tsc -b (the build already runs tsc -b before vite build), npx eslint ., cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml, cargo clippy -- -D warnings. The Ubuntu runner needs the Tauri system deps first: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libssl-dev librsvg2-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev libsoup-3.0-dev. Cache ~/.cargo and src-tauri/target or the Rust job costs several minutes every run. cargo test includes the E6 simulator test, so the runner needs python3 — and that test must FAIL when the simulator is missing (see E6), which is exactly what CI is for. Packaging a release artifact can wait; compiling and testing cannot. See .github/workflows/ci.yml in '~/Desktop/Spectrum Analyzer python' for the shape.
acceptance: A PR that breaks the TypeScript build fails CI
A PR that breaks a Rust test fails CI
The simulator integration test runs in CI, and fails if the simulator is absent

reference_implementations.what: Our hardware. PROTOCOL.md is canonical and verified against the firmware; Python_User_Code/tcd1304.py is the reference host to transliterate.

PyQt6 spectrum analyzer for camera-based sensors. Same layering as ours (ICamera ~ SpectrumDriver, AcquisitionWorker ~ our acquisition thread, SpectrumProcessor ~ process.rs, plus an AxisGenerator we lack). Take: math/calibration.py (E5), the backpressure gate in pipeline/worker.py (E4), the axis-on-demand model (E8), the CI shape (E9). Do NOT take: the C++-fidelity DSP chain ordering, anything 2D-sensor (column summation, ROI rows, exposure/gain scaling, median filter), the saturation/roi channels in SpectrumData, or the Raman axis.
